verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille E in, poke with Q/W, and E back out before you ever land a hook; you win if you catch her Death's Grasp the instant she commits and convert that stall into an R isolate.

brief.thesis: Camille's whole kit is built around committing with E (Hookshot) to a wall and resetting range afterward to refresh her Adaptive Defenses shield and Q (Precision Protocol) timer. Mordekaiser's counter is structural, not stat-based: E (Death's Grasp) pulls all enemies in its area on a 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown, and landing it the moment she dashes in erases the escape her entire pattern depends on. Measured win rate sits at an even 50% over 1,945 games, but Mordekaiser holds the lane and solo-kill edge — this is a matchup decided by who reads cooldowns better, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: her E (Hookshot) is up near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can dash in, empowered-auto with Q, cone-poke with W, then E back out to heal off the outer-cone slow tick. Respect this window — don't overextend into her landing spot.

yourWindow.what: She has no reposition tool for 16 to 12 seconds depending on rank. Walk her down, land Q (Obliterate) and autos to stack Darkness Rise, and force the extended trade she can no longer leave.

start.why: The 53.2% win rate, 78.9%-pick start over 1,801 games — the extra mana and sustain let you hold Obliterate and Death's Grasp off cooldown through her poke instead of recalling early.

boots.why: 54.5%-win Mercury's Treads exists for other CC-heavy lanes, but Camille's damage comes almost entirely from autos (passive, Q, R bonus auto damage) — Steelcaps' flat auto-damage reduction is the 78.1%-pick default here for good reason.

core.why: Every spell hit now slows — stack it through Death's Grasp or Obliterate the moment she dashes in, so even if she lands, she can't walk back out.
Omnivamp and the ramping true damage reward the exact extended-fight, isolate-and-grind pattern your R and W sustain set up against a diver like Camille.
Burn damage punishes a target you've already slowed with Rylai's and locked out of escape — this is the highest-win-rate full path at 58.3% over 199 games.

you need an extra active tool to punish her E engage beyond your own cooldowns
the game goes long and you need the added stat flexibility over a fourth burn item

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror rewards exactly the prolonged, multi-hit trades your R isolate and E pull create, and the healing conversion at full stacks keeps you topped up through Camille's auto-reset pattern.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 81.2% of games at a 51.6% win rate — Ignite's healing reduction directly undercuts her W (Tactical Sweep) cone heal and Adaptive Defenses sustain, which is what turns your measured solo-kill advantage into an actual kill.

playing.title: Pull her the moment she lands
playing.detail: Camille's E only takes her to a nearby wall and knocks up on landing — it isn't a repeatable escape. The instant she commits with it, fire Death's Grasp to drag her back into range before she can reset with autos.

playing.title: Trade right after her Q fires
playing.detail: Her Q (Precision Protocol) is melee-range and recastable for bonus damage if she delays — once she's used it (especially the delayed version), her burst window is spent on its 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown. Step in with Obliterate and autos immediately after.

playing.title: Isolate with R before she all-ins
playing.detail: Realm of Death removes both her teammates and any nearby walls for a future E — use it to start the skirmish, not finish it, so she's stuck trading autos into your sustain with no reset tool.

playing.title: Bank three hits before committing
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs three landed attacks or spells on champions to trigger its damage aura and move speed. Weave in an auto between Q casts so the aura is live when she tries to disengage.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed cone
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep has a visible cast delay before the cone fires. If she misses it, her slow and heal source is down for 12 to 10 seconds depending on rank — follow immediately with Death's Grasp into Obliterate.

playing.title: Pre-Ignite her engage, not her retreat
playing.detail: Since her sustain comes from the W cone heal and her on-hit shield, throwing Ignite the moment she commits (rather than when she's already leaving) denies the healing that lets her survive the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune page, and summoner spells are pulled from 1,945 measured Mordekaiser-vs-Camille games on the current patch; the cooldown reads, trade timing, and engage/disengage logic are this coach's own tactical interpretation, not from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Camille hit and run by using [E] the moment she closes in. Maintain your [P] active to have the upper hand in prolonged fights.
